title: Para Bellum content: combat
description: The auto-resolve battle weights. File: Content/<namespace>/combat.json, exactly ONE across every namespace: the game refuses a second copy and refuses a content set with none. A mod cannot override this file (a recorded limitation; a total-conversion mod would want to, which is why override semantics is the first modding-API item after this sprint). Ratios are per mille, and every figure is a whole number. Integer inputs here buy auditability and one house unit, but the battle arithmetic itself remains floating point. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

defense_weight_per_level_per_mille.description: The defender's bonus per level of terrain defence, per mille.

river_assault_penalty_per_mille.description: The attacker's strength multiplier when assaulting into a river hex, per mille.

luck_spread_per_mille.description: The width of the random swing on each side's strength, per mille.

destroy_floor_strength.description: A unit at or below this strength is destroyed, in strength points.
